title: Collections Manual — Calculating the Late Fee for an Independent Living Billing Period
content:
## Section 1 — The calculation

1.1 A late fee assessed for a billing period of an Independent Living Residency Agreement is computed from the past-due amount of that period.

1.2 The billing period assessed is the billing period of the latest monthly fee charge on the residency ledger, and its charges are the monthly fee charges and the recurring service fee charges carrying that billing period; late fees, community fees and one-time service fees are never among them.

1.3 The past-due amount of the billing period is those charges less the payments posted within the one month ending on the day of assessment.

1.4 The late fee percentage is the late fee percentage of the apartment type's billing schedule.

1.5 The late fee is the greater of the flat late fee of the apartment type and the late fee percentage of the past-due amount of the billing period, the percentage amount rounded to the cent half up.

1.6 No late fee is assessed when the past-due amount of the billing period is below the minimum past-due amount of the apartment type.

## Section 2 — Terms

- **Latest monthly fee charge** — the monthly fee charge most recently posted on the residency ledger; its billing period is the period assessed.
- **Recurring service fee charges** — service fee charges that recur with the billing month (for example a monthly pet fee or a storage or parking rent) carrying that billing period.
- **The one month ending on the day of assessment** — the month running back from the day of assessment to the day after the same date in the previous month; a payment posted on the same date one month earlier is outside it.

## Section 3 — Worked example

The billing schedule figures for every apartment type are a late fee percentage of 1.5, a flat late fee of 75.00 and a minimum past-due amount of 100.00.

Hypothetical ledger: the latest monthly fee charge is for billing period 2026-09. That period carries a base fee charge of 3,968.00, a second person fee charge of 1,045.00 and a monthly pet fee of 35.00, a total of 5,048.00. Payments posted within the one month ending on the day of assessment total 0.00.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Charges of the period | 5,048.00 |
| Less payments in the month | 0.00 |
| Past-due amount | 5,048.00 (not below 100.00) |
| 1.5 percent of 5,048.00 | 75.72 |
| Greater of 75.00 and 75.72 | 75.72 |

With payments of 3,000.00 in the month the past-due amount is 2,048.00; 1.5 percent of it is 30.72, so the greater amount is the flat 75.00. With payments of 4,960.00 the past-due amount is 88.00, below 100.00, and no late fee is assessed.
